_meta: DRAFT — NOT YET IMPORTED (wired automatically by the gen-slices auto-loader). Lead-chasing follow-up round after AF/G.23, 2026-08-13. Transcribed from a prior agent's verified findings (no new web research performed this round). Targets the single most important documented lead flagged in gw-g23-municipal.json's _dropped block: Lei n.º 7/96, de 9 de Dezembro ("Autonomia financeira e patrimonial das Autarquias" / "Lei das Finanças Locais"), Guinea-Bissau's operative municipal-finance law and the presumed source of the concrete revenue formula that Constitution Art. 110 (gw-constituicao-poder-local) only promises 'a estabelecer por lei'. Full verbatim text of the Preâmbulo and Arts. 1-6 was located this round, unpaywalled, at vlex.pt — a commercial legal-publishing platform, not a government site, but the text reproduced is a verbatim government-authored statute, not vlex's paraphrase (same tier as droit-afrique.com/WIPO Lex third-party-hosted-but-verbatim-government-text elsewhere in this project). A second, genuinely government-hosted source (mef.gw's Kontaktu tax portal) independently corroborates the law's short title and confirms partial supersession of one sub-provision.

reports.title: Lei n.º 7/96, de 9 de Dezembro — "Autonomia Financeira e Patrimonial das Autarquias" (Lei das Finanças Locais)
reports.description: Guinea-Bissau's operative municipal-finance law, confirming and quantifying the delegation Constitution Art. 110 makes to ordinary law ('o regime das finanças locais, a estabelecer por lei'). Verbatim text (Preâmbulo plus Arts. 1-6) reached this round via an unpaywalled preview at vlex.pt: "PREÂMBULO Inicia-se com o presente diploma o lançamento das bases financeiras com o propósito de permitir as Autarquias Locais caminharem em vista aos objectivos plasmados com a sua criação... ARTIGO 1º (Autonomia financeira e patrimonial das Autarquias) Os Municípios, Secções Autárquicas e Juntas Locais têm património e finanças próprias cuja gestão compete aos respectivos órgãos... ARTIGO 6º (Contribuição do FEF) O montante global do FEF é repartido pelos Municípios através da aplicação dos seguintes critérios: 50% igualmente por todos os Municípios; 25% na razão directa do número de habitantes; 25% na razão directa da área. A lei do OGE fixa em cada ano um montante não inferior a 10% da receita tributária executada no ano transacto..." (text cut off by the platform's paywall after this point) — a real, quantified Fundo de Equilíbrio Financeiro (FEF) inter-municipal transfer formula: 50% split equally across all municípios, 25% by population, 25% by area, funded by a minimum 10% share of the prior year's executed tax revenue set annually in the OGE (state budget) law. CAVEAT on sourcing: vlex.pt (https://vlex.pt/vid/financeira-patrimonial-autarquias-dezembro-36574017) is a commercial third-party legal-publishing platform, not a Guinea-Bissau government domain — but the quoted text is a verbatim reproduction of the government-authored statute, not vlex's own paraphrase or summary, so it is treated as usable primary-source text under this branch's established convention for verbatim-government-text-via-third-party-hosting (the same tier already applied to droit-afrique.com and WIPO Lex mirrors elsewhere in this project), with the third-party-hosting caveat recorded explicitly rather than silently. Independent corroboration reached this round from a genuinely government-hosted source, mef.gw's Kontaktu tax portal (https://kontaktu.mef.gw/legislation, a Ministério da Economia e Finanças subdomain), which confirms the law's short title "Lei das Finanças Locais" and its citation as "Lei n°7/96, de 9 de dezembro" in its own text: "Transitoriamente fica o Governo central autorizado a lançar a derrama prevista na alínea c) do n°1 do art.3° da Lei n°7/96, de 9 de dezembro (Lei das Finanças Locais)." RESOLVES A PRIOR AMBIGUITY: this round confirms Lei n.º 5/96 ("Lei de Bases das Autarquias Locais", the framework/organic law, still not located in full text — see gw-g23-municipal.json's _dropped block) and Lei n.º 7/96 (this finance law) are DISTINCT instruments, not two labels for the same text — vlex.pt's own text of Lei 7/96 is self-contained, dated 9 December 1996, and titled exactly "Autonomia financeira e patrimonial das Autarquias", separately from the framework law's own "Lei de Bases" title. OPEN CAVEAT ON CURRENT FORCE: the Kontaktu page's own markup shows the derrama-rate sub-provision of Art. 3º n.º1 c) (a flat 1% derrama rate) has been struck through / superseded — "Redação atribuída pelo art. 9º da Lei nº 1/2021", replacing it with a reference to "A taxa da derrama prevista no artigo 206º, da Lei nº 5/2018, de 7 de agosto, relativa ao Código da Administração Autárquica, é de 2%." This confirms only that ONE narrow sub-provision (the derrama rate) has been superseded, by Lei nº 5/2018 (Código da Administração Autárquica) as amended by Lei nº 1/2021 — it does NOT establish that the whole of Lei 7/96 is repealed, and in particular the Article 6 FEF formula quoted above is NOT confirmed to remain in force by anything found this round; its current-force status should be treated as unconfirmed rather than assumed, pending a future round checking whether Lei 5/2018's Código da Administração Autárquica recasts the FEF mechanism as well.

_dropped.why: RESOLVED 2026-08-30: a fresh, independently-verified fetch of the same vlex.pt page (confirmed by two separate readers, not just re-trusting the earlier round) found the citation this entry said was absent, right in the preamble: 'no uso dos poderes Constitucionais definidos nos artigos 86º, alínea b) e 1l0º [110º], o seguinte' -- Article 110 is exactly the finance-regime delegation article this branch concerns. Wired gw-lei-7-96-financas-locais -> gw-constituicao-poder-local (cites) in gw-autarquias-locais-laws-2026-08-30.json. The earlier round's 'paywall cuts the text off before any article number' explanation does not match what a fresh fetch of the same URL shows -- the citation is in the preamble, before any paywall could plausibly cut in. Original entry follows. Topically this law implements Constitution Art. 110's delegation ('o regime das finanças locais, a estabelecer por lei'), and Art. 1's title ('Autonomia financeira e patrimonial das Autarquias') echoes Art. 110's own wording almost exactly — but the vlex.pt preview text of Lei 7/96 reached this round (Preâmbulo plus Arts. 1-6) never cites the Constitution by article number, and the paywall cuts the text off before any later article might. Per the evidence-strict citation rule, no documented edge is drawn despite the strong topical relationship; recorded here as a proximity note rather than an edge, per the task's own instruction to prefer a note over an unsupported edge.

Both instruments concern sub-national revenue-sharing formulas (Lei 7/96 Art. 6's FEF inter-municipal split; Decreto 6/2018 Art. 94's land-tax split), and both are FCFA-denominated Guinea-Bissau fiscal-transfer mechanisms, but the two texts as retrieved never cross-cite each other and their beneficiary classes differ (Lei 7/96's FEF distributes among 'Municípios'; Decreto 6/2018 Art. 94 distributes to 'comunidades locais' and 'autoridades administrativas regionais e setoriais', a different, deconcentrated tier — the same non-equation already flagged in gw-g23-municipal.json's _dropped block for that decree). No textual citation basis for an edge; recorded as topical proximity only, per the task instruction.

_dropped.edge: gw-lei-7-96-financas-locais -> Lei nº 5/2018 (Código da Administração Autárquica), as amended by Lei nº 1/2021
_dropped.why: Confirmed this round to exist and to be in force via mef.gw's Kontaktu tax portal (https://kontaktu.mef.gw/legislation), which documents that Lei nº 5/2018's Art. 206 (as further amended by Art. 9º of Lei nº 1/2021) now sets the derrama rate previously fixed at 1% by Lei 7/96 Art. 3º n.º1 c) — the tax portal's own markup shows that sub-provision of Lei 7/96 struck through/superseded. This is genuine, real, and named evidence that a later, more comprehensive municipal-administration code (the 'Código da Administração Autárquica') exists and may supersede more of Lei 7/96 than just the single derrama-rate sub-provision confirmed this round — most importantly, whether it recasts or replaces the Article 6 FEF (Fundo de Equilíbrio Financeiro) formula that is this node's core quantified finding. Full text of Lei nº 5/2018 (and of the amending Lei nº 1/2021) was not located this round — a real, named, documented lead for a future round to resolve the FEF formula's current-force status.
